messages.subject: Re: Autoload Deducer in JGR

Right now I want to build a custom Ubuntu Live CD with R, JGR and
Deducer installed. The question is: the start script for JGR (/usr/
local/lib/R/site-library/JGR/scripts/run) can be edited to autoload
Deducer and DeducerExtras?

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Autoload Deducer in JGR
parts:
How about just copying over the .JGRprefsrc file to the CD, making sure the DefaultPackages entry contains Deducer and DeducerExtras.

The relevant line in the file:
            <entry key="DefaultPackages" value="base, DeducerExtras, Deducer, methods, stats, graphics, grDevices, utils, datasets"/>

Ian
